clauses.title: q nonzero independently of trace
clauses.required_hypotheses: R!=0 from positive normalizer; actual unchanged contact equation.
clauses.constructed_assertion: The retained contact equation (1+q)P5(r)=r^5 with r=(t-1)^2 forces q!=0 over Q, independently of root and trace equations.
